institutionsIntro: Manage the institutions you represent and respond to invitations.
newIntro: New profiles are publicly labeled unverified. Apply for verification after setting up the profile.
none: You do not represent any institutions yet.
name: Institution name
handleHint: Use 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. Start with a letter or number.
linkHint: Use a public HTTPS link without a query string or fragment.
contactHint: Only owners and administrators can see this address.
identityLocked: Identity fields are locked during review and after verification.
inviteHelp: Enter an AyiNou username. Invitations appear in that member’s account for seven days.
claimInstructions: Sign in and use the institution’s public handle in the verification form.
verificationIntro: Submit public references for manual review. An application does not grant a badge.
evidenceHelp: Add 1–3 HTTPS links, one per line, to official public sources. Keep identity documents, files and private links out of the submission.
founderClosureReason: Closed because Founder Verified was granted. This application received no regular identity approval.
personalRequestPending: You already have a personal verification request under review. Wait for it to close before submitting another.
personalAlreadyVerified: You already hold this verification, so there’s no need to request it again.
reviewIntro: Review the official sources and record a written decision. Approval requires two independent reviewers.
conflictFree: I have no conflict of interest in this application.
unavailable: This institution action is unavailable. Try again.
invalid: Review the fields and try again.
conflict: These details are already in use or the action is unavailable in the current state.
forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
rate: The limit was reached. Try again later.
